RAF Bodney.fact: Their mission, called Operation Bulbasket, was sabotage of SS units coming north to oppose the Normandy invasion.

RAF Bodney.question: The group was ultimately captured, and _____, along with the others, was murdered
RAF Bodney.fact: Lincoln Delmar Bundy, a North American P-51 Mustang fighter pilot flying from here, was shot down over occupied France on 10 June 1944. The group was ultimately captured, and Bundy, along with the others, was murdered.
